findings.claim: The executable code in ai-research-agent is only a Hello-World placeholder. PROJECT.md still says the architecture and success metrics are undefined. The subtree therefore does not provide implementation evidence for an autonomous research agent.
findings.current_implication: Classify this subtree as prototype/planning history rather than reusable autonomous-agent implementation.

findings.claim: The marketing document claims browser automation, recurring scheduling and marketing generation as delivered capabilities while task state records browser automation as in_progress and marketing/social launch as pending; the project document still marks architecture as undefined. Promotional narrative therefore overstates the executable/task evidence.
findings.current_implication: RAE/Harness must type marketing, task status, executable tests and runtime measurements as different evidence classes. Natural-language capability claims may not promote implementation status without executable receipts.

findings.claim: The subtree stores a browser state file containing live-style cookie/session material. Values are intentionally not reproduced in RAE.
findings.current_implication: Archive ingestion and replay need automatic secret/session detection, redaction and capability-scoped runtime state. Browser profiles/cookies must never be treated as ordinary durable research text.

credit.reason: No reusable autonomous research-agent implementation is present; the useful value is provenance/security failure evidence and exact coverage.

progress_accounting.reason: A local subtree closure does not freeze the combined Level-0 denominator.

cross_branch_feedback.harness: Add evidence-class separation tests: marketing/prose and task-completed flags cannot satisfy capability predicates; sanitize browser/session state before persistence.
cross_branch_feedback.claygraph: Store evidence class and provenance on capability assertions so promotional text cannot become graph truth.
cross_branch_feedback.unifieddb: Separate durable research facts from runtime session secrets and browser profile state.
cross_branch_feedback.frank: Do not inherit this prototype as agent architecture; retain only its negative-result lessons.
